title: 去 DMV 办驾照和车辆注册
summary: 去车管所更新驾照、注册车辆：带什么证件、排队说什么，全程英语这样说。

featuredPhrase.en: I'd like to renew my driver's license.

phrases.en: I'd like to renew my driver's license.
I need to register my car.
When will I get my new license?
phrases.zh: 新驾照什么时候能拿到？

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.en: Hi, I'd like to renew my driver's license.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.en: Yes, at 2 pm. Here's my current license.
dialogue.zh: 有，下午 2 点。这是我的旧驾照。

dialogue.speaker: Clerk
dialogue.en: Please look at the camera for your photo. Do you need to update your address?
dialogue.zh: 请看镜头拍照。地址需要更新吗？

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.en: Yes, I just moved. I also need to register my car.
dialogue.zh: 要，我刚搬家。另外我还要给车做注册。

dialogue.speaker: Clerk
dialogue.en: Bring your title and proof of insurance to window 5.
dialogue.zh: 带上车辆 title 和保险证明去 5 号窗口。
